summary: ROUND 6B.2c bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Historical expedition Sewer Nest (301b6f17-...) now exposes adventurer_ids (3 UUIDs) via GET /api/expeditions/{id} fallback-reconstruction from expedition_members snapshot. Frontend ExpeditionReport renders the 'Save as squad' button correctly; clicking deep-links to /squads/new with type=dungeon_3, adventurer_ids and suggested_name; SquadBuilder pre-populates name 'Squadra Sewer Nest' and selects 3 adventurers (Soren, Nyx, Vera the Bold).

critical_code_review_comments: Backend fallback at services.py:727-728 mutates the in-memory exp dict before calling expedition_public — correct & minimal, but be aware adventurer_ids is NOT backfilled in the DB (read-only reconstruction). Acceptable per design (idempotent, no migrations). New runs persist the field directly via exp_doc.adventurer_ids (line 593).

Frontend condition `(e.adventurer_ids || []).length > 0` is defensive against missing field — good. Type inference '=== 5 ? dungeon_5 : dungeon_3' is correct for current dungeon sizes; if a 4-member dungeon were ever added the fallback would mis-tag it as dungeon_3 — minor future-proofing concern.

List endpoint GET /api/expeditions also exposes adventurer_ids (because expedition_public() includes it), so a deep-link save-as-squad could even be offered from the expedition list view in a future iteration.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused pre-existing historical expedition 301b6f17-7347-41aa-9536-ebf132c51934 (Sewer Nest victory).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ROUND 6B.2c save-as-squad CTA fully working on historical victories. Backend fallback in services.py:724-728 reconstructs adventurer_ids on-the-fly. To re-verify, login as tester and GET /api/expeditions/<sewer-nest-id> — adventurer_ids must be a 3-UUID array.
rca of the issue: Root cause: expedition documents created before ROUND 6B.2c did not persist `adventurer_ids` in MongoDB; the frontend gates the 'Save as squad' button on `(e.adventurer_ids || []).length > 0`, so historical victories rendered without the button. Fix: (a) new expeditions persist `adventurer_ids` in exp_doc (services.py:593); (b) GET /api/expeditions/{id} reconstructs the field from `expedition_members` snapshot when absent (services.py:727-728). Both layers verified by automated tests.
